name: One Week of Eternity
source:
The story is told from the point-of-view of Alyssa Cruz, an 11 year old girl who is suddenly diagnosed with a terminal illness from which the doctors estimate she would have approximately one week left to live. The story follows Alyssa's daily life with her friends and family. One Week of Eternity explores Alyssa's external and internal struggles as she copes with the reality of death just as she has barely begun to take her first steps into adulthood.

[From the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170711144011/http://teacup.lunaen.com/index.php?topic=35.0]Official site[/url]]
translation:
故事从11岁少女艾丽莎·克鲁兹的视角展开。她突然被确诊患有绝症，医生估计她只剩大约一周生命。作品记录了艾丽莎与朋友、家人共同度过的日常。《One Week of Eternity》描绘了艾丽莎面对死亡现实时内心与外界的挣扎，而此时她才刚刚踏出迈向成年的最初几步。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170711144011/http://teacup.lunaen.com/index.php?topic=35.0]官方网站[/url]]
